# ARNZO PDF Toolkit

> Free, privacy-first PDF tools that process documents locally in the browser.

Website: https://pdf.arnzo.com/
Publisher: ARNZO (https://arnzo.com/)

## Privacy
PDF contents are processed in the user's browser. The application is designed not to upload PDF documents to ARNZO servers. No account is required.

## Tools
- Merge PDF files
- Split PDF pages
- Rotate PDF pages
- Delete selected pages
- Extract selected pages
- Convert JPG and PNG images to PDF

## Technology
React, TypeScript, Vite and pdf-lib.
